projects.title: Public News Text Processing and Analysis

bullets.text: Under supervision, wrote Python functions to parse provided news records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.
Ran supplied NLTK tokenization and word-count steps on document samples, then inspected vocabulary examples with guidance before attempting classification.
Under supervision, validated pandas merges with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and used Matplotlib to visualize how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
Ran a supplied Python notebook to load provided research abstract records and edited simple filters and loops with step-by-step guidance.
Executed supplied NLTK tokenization steps on the research abstract collection and inspected query terms and example matches with guidance.

Under supervision, executed and inspected supplied pandas merges joining document identifiers to metadata, checked unmatched records, ran supplied Matplotlib group-comparison visualizations, and documented missing-data handling.
